answer: The protocol employs a glacier-based consensus layer where each autonomous agent must stake a unique beacon signature to initiate a thread of verifiable computation, ensuring that Sybil attacks are economically infeasible due to the quadratic cost of generating multiple beacons across distinct threads, thereby creating a strong equilibrium where rational agents are incentivized to maintain honest behavior, as any deviation would result in significant slashing penalties and capital lockup, effectively securing the network against Sybil resistance.
